The iPhone 18 Pro Max pre-order date is widely expected to be Saturday, September 12, 2026, rather than the typical Friday launch window. Several reports say orders could open at 12:00 a.m. Pacific Time, which is 3:00 a.m. Eastern Time—important for shoppers in cities such as Miami, New York, Orlando, Houston, Chicago, Los Angeles and San Francisco. [...] For buyers in the U.S., the most frequently reported retail launch date is Friday, September 18, 2026. That timing would follow Apple’s usual pattern of opening sales approximately one week after pre-orders begin, but it should be treated as an expected—not confirmed—date until Apple updates its website and Apple Store app.
